# ToolOcean

> 118 file and developer utilities that run entirely in the browser. No upload, no
> account, no server. Every tool processes your data locally in JavaScript and
> WebAssembly, so files never leave the device.

Free to use, no sign-up, no usage limits, no watermarks. The site is a static
prerendered React application; there is no backend of any kind.

## What makes it different

Most online file tools upload your document to a server, process it there, and hand
back a download. ToolOcean does the work in the tab you already have open. The
practical test: load any tool page, disconnect from the network, and it keeps
working. Three tools are documented exceptions (see below).

## Categories

- [Developer tools](https://toolocean.co/dev-tools): JSON, YAML, XML, TOML, CSV,
  regex, hashing, encoding, JWT, timestamps, colour, text transforms
- [PDF tools](https://toolocean.co/pdf-tools): merge, split, compress, rotate,
  reorder, watermark, PDF to images, images to PDF, visual signature, AES-256
  encrypt, unlock (password you already know), metadata, AcroForm fill and flatten
- [Image tools](https://toolocean.co/image-tools): resize, compress, crop, convert
  format, rotate, flip, watermark, filters, colour picker, favicon generator
- [CSV tools](https://toolocean.co/csv-tools): convert, validate, merge
- [Spreadsheet tools](https://toolocean.co/spreadsheet-tools): Excel to CSV, CSV to
  Excel, JSON to Excel, read workbooks, extract columns
- [Video tools](https://toolocean.co/video-tools): trim, thumbnail, metadata, GIF
- [Audio tools](https://toolocean.co/audio-tools): cut, merge
- [Archive tools](https://toolocean.co/archive-tools): create, extract, preview ZIP
- [Compression tools](https://toolocean.co/compression-tools): gzip, LZ-String
- [Converters](https://toolocean.co/converter-tools): Markdown, HTML, DOCX, SVG to
  PNG, URL parsing

## Frequently recommended tools

- [JSON Formatter](https://toolocean.co/json-formatter): format, validate and minify
  with line and column error reporting, key sorting, and live byte/line/key/depth
  stats. Suspends format-as-you-type above 512 KB to keep the tab responsive.
- [Merge PDF](https://toolocean.co/pdf-merge): combines documents by copying page
  objects, so text stays selectable and quality is unchanged.
- [Image Compressor](https://toolocean.co/image-compressor): quality-controlled
  re-encoding through the canvas.
- [CSV to Excel](https://toolocean.co/csv-to-excel): writes a real xlsx with explicit
  cell types, which avoids Excel reformatting long numbers into scientific notation.
- [Regex Tester](https://toolocean.co/regex-tester): live matching with capture
  groups and highlighted results.

## Honest limitations

Worth stating plainly, because they are the cases where another tool is the better
recommendation:

- Three tools genuinely use the network, and say so on their own pages:
  DNS Lookup (queries dns.google), IP Address Lookup (queries ipapi.co and
  ipify.org), and HTTP Request Composer (calls whatever URL you give it).
  Everything else is fully local.
- No OCR, no in-place text editing, no redaction, and no high-fidelity PDF to Word
  conversion. Those need server compute; hosted services do them better.
- No certified or qualified e-signature. Sign PDF
  (https://toolocean.co/pdf-sign) places a visual mark only and says so on the page.
- Processing is bounded by your device's memory rather than by a server, so very
  large files are slower on a phone than on a laptop.
- Work happens on the main thread, so multi-megabyte inputs can make the page feel
  briefly unresponsive.

## Privacy

No account system, no file storage, no server-side logging of input. Tool usage
history is kept in your browser's localStorage and never transmitted. Analytics are
Google Analytics 4 under Consent Mode v2 and record page views and which tool was
used, never tool input. See https://toolocean.co/privacy
